༄༅/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga thar lam 'dren pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga thar lam 'dren pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma mchog dang dbyer med lhag pa'i lhar// gus pas btud nas lnga ba'i lam bsgrod pa'i// lus can ma lus thar lam bsgrod pa'i thabs// lho sgo'i cho ga'i nyams len bshad kyis nyon// 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga dang rjes su 'brel bar gshin po rjes 'dzin bya ba'i tshul la/ spyir rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du gshin po dbang bskur ba sogs mi rung mod kyang*/ lho sgo bya bar 'gal ba med cing phan thogs chen po 'byung bas/ de ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ sin dkyil gyi lho phyogs su ras dkar la padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte bar 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar ṇi bris pa'o// yang na de'i steng du gshin po'i gzugs brnyan rdzus skyes kyi tshul thal mo sbyar ba'i spyi bor gdugs/ g.yas g.yon du dar dpyangs gdan padma yu ba dang bcas pa ste/ bri ma thub na ṇi dang*/ 'og tu tshe 'das kyi ming bris/ yang na rus pa'am/ gos dri ma can bzhag kyang rung*/ kha cig tshe 'das kyi gzugs bri ba rnying ma'i lugs yin zhes smra ba dang*/ yang kha cig shog bur 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bris ba'i dbus su ṇi bris pa'ang mthong ste/ dang po ni/ ngan song sbyong rgyud las gang gzugs brnyan la yang dbang bskur bar byos shig ces gsal bar gsungs pa ma mthong bar zad cing*/ phyi mas ni gdan dang rten gyi khyad par ma phyed par gya tshoms su spyod pa'o// de'i mdun du zhi drag gi sbyangs chas gtor ma gsum/ ting lo gsum/ chang bu gsum rnams dang*/ bzlas pa'i skabs su bye ma'am yungs kar la sngags kyi nus pa stim pa/ gu gul dang bcas pa bshams/ cho ga'i bdag 'jug cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol gyi bar song nas/ dmigs rten bum chus sbyangs/ gtor ma rnams la'ang chu gtsang gis bran/ dpon slob rnams kyis dmigs pa ma yengs pa'i sgo nas/

oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇā gṛhṇā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛhṇā pā ya gṛhṇā pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swā bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su sbyong stegs padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa khru gang pa/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar ṇi yongs su gyur pa las 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du tshe las 'das pa/ tshe 'das kyi ming dngos su smos dgos te/ rgyud las/ de yi ming nas smos nas kyang*// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ che go mo/ zhes bya ba phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ rang gi snying kha'i bam̐ dang tshe 'das kyi snying kha'i ṇi las 'od zer 'phros pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa khams gsum gang na gnas kyang 'dir mchis par gyur cig rdor dril mi dgos hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la sems kyi dmigs pa tshe 'das kyis rnam shes gang na gnas kyang rang dbang med par bkug par bsams la sgrigs 'don byas te/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i rnam par shes pa khams gsum skye gnas bzhi rigs drug gang na gnas kyang skad cig gis rten 'di nyid la thim par gyur cig oṃ ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ nges par rten la thim par bsam/ de nas lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo dang mtha' bzhi sgreng ba sdig pa dral ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/

oṃ shwa dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ a pa na ye hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bid sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni badzra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid tra tha/ oṃ badzra pā ni bi spho ṭa ya/ sarba a pa ya nā sha ya/ bhandha ni pra mo kṣa ya/ sarba a bha ya ga te bhyaḥsarba sa twa naṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra sa ma ya tra tha/ zhes lan gsum brjod dgos te/ 'di sdig pa dral ba'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ rdo rje bsdams pa dral la/ oṃ badzra bhandha tra thā/ yang yang brjod/ tshe 'das kyi gnas gsum rdo rje khu tshur btugs par mos nas phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ sarba bid badzra a dhi tiṣṭha dzñā na sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa a dkar po dri ma med pa/ sdig pa sbyang rung gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams/ de nas zhi bas sbyong ba ni/ gtor ma re re rten la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bi ghā nan na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ uṅga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ghṛ hne daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis zhi bas sbyangs/ 'di la zhi ba'i sbyang ba zhes brjod de/ rdzas sngags gnyis ka zhi ba yin pa'i phyir ro// de nas ting lo chang bu bcas rten la g.yon du bskor zhing*/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs lan gsum gyis zhi drag phyed mas sbyangs/ 'di la zhe drag phyed ma'i sbyang ba zhes brjod de/ rdzas zhi ba dang sngags drag po yin pa'i phyir ro// 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing*/ gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar chad byed pa dang*/ slar yang gshin po de nyid kyi cha byad bzung ste nye 'brel dang 'jig rten pa gzhan rnams bslu bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma lam brngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig

gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal ba brgyar 'gas par bya'o// ces brjod cing gu gul gyis gdugs/ rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas te gtor ma phyir dor/ rgyas par byed na/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo me ltar 'bar ba la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren gdul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyi gshegs su gsol// o badzra kro dhā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ehya ha ིsa spyan drangs/ oṃ padma ka ma lā ya staṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu ppe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ hūm̐/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*// bsdig pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod// bskal ba me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dpa' bo stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs// khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod//

ces bstod/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la/ gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod par byed cing*/ gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa dang*/ slar yang gshin po de nyid kyi cha byad bzung ste/ nye 'brel dang 'jig rten pa gzhan bslu bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs gang yin pa de dag thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pa des tshim par bgyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams mgo bo 'tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ rol mo'i sgra drag po bya zhing*/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs dkar gyis drabs pa ni drag po'i sbyang ba ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yod de sngags dang rdzas gnyis ka drag po yin pa'i phyir ro// de nas sdig pa bsreg pa'i phyir rten gyi mdun du til g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu bzhag tshe las 'das pa che go mo zhes bya ba khyed rang gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad snying khar yi ge kam̐ nag po'i rnam par gnas pa rlung gis gyen la btegs sna'i bu ga nas thon/

sdig pa ra can gyi rnam pas mdun gyi til la thim/ g.yas su ye shes kyi mer bsregs/ g.yon du rgya mtsho chen po'i chur dor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba pa paṃ da ha na badzra ye swā hā/ byas la mchod g.yog pas til mtheb srin gyis blangs la/ lag pa g.yas pas g.yas su bskor/ g.yon pas g.yon du bskor/ gnyis kas g.yas su bskor te/ me dang chu nang du blug de nas me de chu la bcug phyir 'phang ngo*// 'di la kha cig skabs 'dir rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg byed pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig til la sdig pa'i gzugs byed pa sogs 'dug mod/ dang po ni 'dir ma 'brel zhing*/ phyi ma ni de ltar byed pa gzhan du bshad kyang 'dir mi dgos te tshig gi nus pas shes par nus so// de nas phyir bzlog bya ba// gtsug dgu'i rgyud las/ yungs dkar me tog dang ldan pas// sngags rnams bzlos shing ldog par bya// zhes dang*/ las kyi sgrib pa 'joms pa'i rgyud las/ sa'am/ til lam/ yungs dkar ram chu gang yang rung ba la bzlas brjod byas te/ rus pa'am/ shi ba'i lus la gtor ram khrus byas na/ de ngan song du skyes pa yang zhag bdun gyis gdon mi za bar thar te mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes gsung pas/ kaṃ ka ni dang*/ dur ga dang*/ yig brgya dang*/ oṃ gsum ma sogs gzungs sngags byin rlabs can mang du bzlas pa'i nus pa bye ma'am/ yungs kar la bstim/ de rten la brab cing*/ oṃ gsum ma dang*/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ga ti he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ga te he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma thā ma thā sarba tirya ga te he tu na hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshe 'das kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag par gyur cig ces brjod cing*/ sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod pa phyag len la mdzad do// de nas khrus bya ba la mchod g.yog pas sku phyis phrag g.yon du bkal/ g.yon me long dang g.yas bum pa 'dzin pas thog mar dkyil 'khor la me long bstan te/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣa ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes me long la bum chu blug rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*/ sems can lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs slad du// rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣa ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i gsung la 'gag pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i gsung la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣa ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i thugs la 'khrul pa mi mnga' yang*// sems can yid kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣa ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhi ba lhas/ de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣa ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi 'o// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.ā ka ya bi shwa dha na ye swā hā/ zhes me long la sku gzugs shar ba'i chus de rnams phyis par bsam/ de nas chu de bum par blug de nas sku shas rten la chu 'thor zhing*/ (mar me mdzad kyi mi 'khrugs pa'i rgya gzhung las bshad pa/)'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bya 'o// oṃ gsum ma bzla zhing rol mo dang bcas pas 'khru/

/de bzhin du/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu// khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// tshul khrims dri yis legs bgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bya 'o// oṃ gsum ma 'don/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu// khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// bzod pa dri yis legs bgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bya 'o// oṃ gsum ma 'don/ 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu// le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// brtson pa dri yis legs bgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bya 'o// oṃ gsum ma 'don/ 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu// rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// bsam gtan dri yis legs bgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bya 'o// oṃ gsum ma 'don/ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu// shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// shes rab dri yis legs bgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bya 'o// oṃ gsum ma 'don/

ces bkru/ (rin chen 'bar ba las/) chu bo drug gi khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// dri chu drug gi khrus byas pas// dri ma rnams drug sbyong mdzad pa// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis// yon tan thams cad dang ldan zhing*// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi 'o// oṃ gsum ma 'don/ zhes sngags dang bcas pas 'khru/ de nas/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dag nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur cig /ces bkru/ de nas/ (stong chen rab 'joms las/) 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan dam chos dug mi mnga'// dam chos bden pas dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dug mi mnga'// dge 'dun bden pas dug bcom mo// shlau ka re re'i mtshams su gzungs dang khrus bya/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs nas dge ba gsum dang ldan par gyur cig bden stobs brjod pas bkru ba'o/ (rma bya chen mo las/) sa 'di dug gi pha yin te// sa 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum sa yi nang du song*// oṃ gsum ma 'don/ chu 'di dug gi pha yin te// chu 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum chu yi nang du song*// oṃ gsum ma 'don/

me 'di dug gi pha yin te// me 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum me yi nang du song*// oṃ gsum ma 'don/ rlung 'di dug gi pha yin te// rlung 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum rlung gi nang du song*// oṃ gsum ma 'don/ zhes tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su dril bsil dang bcas khrus bya/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas skyes pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa 'byung ba bzhi'i chos nyid kyi ngang du thim nas sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig ces brjod la/ 'di la kha cig sa chu me rlung sogs khyer nas rten la 'phyag pa'i tshul 'dug pa lugs gzhan dang 'dres pa yin gyis/ rang lugs bum chu gtor ba kho nas mchog par dpal ldan bsod nams rtse mo'i bde mchog gi dus mtha' dang*/ rje btsun rin po che'i gsung rab las rgyas par bshad pas 'di kho na ltar bya'o// de nas mchod g.yog pas rten la bum chu 'thor zhing*/ gzhan rnams kyi shlau ka re re'i mtshams su dril bu bsil zhing me tog 'thor ba dang bcas/ (yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa nas bshad/) gang la ser sna rnams chags pa// rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang la bde ba mnga' mdzad des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi// thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag skyong des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la// gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa// phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor cing*// don 'grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyod la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni// nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yo zhing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig

/sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyi bsams pa yis// khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam du bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*// khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur// khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i skye rgu thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal zhing bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod la/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ 'au/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol du tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba khyod rang gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags pa bya dgos pas de'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin gyis/ khyed rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas 'di nyid du bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa ni rten gyi stobs/ de dag gis spyan sngar khyod rang gi pha mas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems drag po skyes pa ni rnam par bsun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang sdig pa'i las nam yang mi bgyid snyam pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ de ltar du bgyis pa sdig sgrib ji ltar che yang 'dag nges snyam pa nyams pa sor chud pa'i stobs ste stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bshags pa bgyi'o snyam pas lus gus pa'i sgo nas thal mo sbyor/ ngag gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba dang skyabs 'gro'i rjes zlos gyis/ yid gus pa'i sgo nas dad mos kyi shugs drag po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba'i mos pa gyis/

zhes brda' bya/ bu la sogs pa'i nye du yod na ming byang bzung nas phyag byed du bcug la/ (legs grub kyi rgyud las/) sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pas 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol na grol ba'i lam yang ston// slab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*// nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs rnyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/ (zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i/) gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob ba'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa rnam sel ba// bdag ni skyabs su mchi lags so// de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad pa// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin tshe 'das skyabs su mchi// tshe 'das 'jigs pa cher mthong nas// kun tu bzang la tshe 'das 'bul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la tshe 'das kyi// lus 'di bdag gis dbul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyams thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig can 'di la bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni/ thugs rjes bdag nyid thams cad la// phyag 'tshal snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong nas gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bcur 'byer byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/

mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// sdig pa sbyang du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas brjod cing gsol ba 'debs par bsam/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis sangs rgyas rdo rje chos sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa'i sku can du gsal ba la mchod bstod bgyis pa'i mos pa mdzod// ces brjod/ de nas oṃ badzra dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra titstsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du mtshan sngags re re sbyar ba'i puṣpe nas shabda 'i bar/ 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi sku// kun rtog ye shes rdo rje'i sku// ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la/ /zhes bstod/ de nas tshogs la sogs pa'i 'dod yon chab kyi bran la/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'dod yon kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ a kā ro lan gsum dang*/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sogs lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gdangs dang bcas/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan 'phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun nas gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams// rnam shes rten gyi lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing tshe 'das byang chub myur thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ru pa ka ma gu ṇa pu dzi ti āḥhūm̐/ zhes me long phul/ de bzhin du/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// rnam shes rten gyi lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing tshe 'das byang chub myur thob shog

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shabda ka ma gu ṇa pu dzi ti āḥhūm̐/ rol mo phul/ phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang*// a dkar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// rnam shes rten gyi lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing tshe 'das byang chub myur thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gandhe ka ma gu ṇa pu dzi ti āḥhūm̐/ dri bzang gi bdud rtsi phul/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// rnam shes rten gyi lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing tshe 'das byang chub myur thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rwa sa ka ma gu ṇa pu dzi ti āḥhūm̐/ tshogs phud phul/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// rig bya'i khyad par lus dbang tshim byed rnams// rnam shes rten gyi lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shing tshe 'das byang chub myur thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta parshe ka ma gu ṇa pu dzi ti āḥhūm̐/ ces na bza' phul/ tshe las 'das pa'i mig gi yul du gzugs mdzes pa/ rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan pa/ sna'i yul du dri zhim pa// lce'i yul du ro mngar ba/ lus kyi yul du reg bya 'jam pa la sogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la zhen chags med pa'i sgo nas longs spyod par gyur cig / ces brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi mdun du mar me spar ba zhig bzhag byang bu slob dpon gyi phyag tu phul/ gsung spangs mtho ba dang bcas/ 'o/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba khyod nyon cig 'di ltar gzugs la sogs pa yod par snang ba'i chos thams cad dang*/ bdag gzhan gyi tshor ba bde sdug 'du shes la sogs pa thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa la bden par bzung ste/ don la med bzhin du 'khrul snang gis sdus pa'i sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab pa myong dgos pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje dung pa re bsgom/ stong nyid snying rje zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas khyod rang gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib/

da lta bar do'i 'khrul snang*/ phyi ma ngan song gsum du skye 'gyur gyi las ngan ji snyed yod pa thams cad blos phyogs gcig tu bsdoms te bsreg bya bud shing gi rnam par gyur/ skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga rnam par dag pa'i nus mthu/ nye du 'brel ba shul na mchis pa rnams kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bgyis pa dang bgyi 'gyur bgyid bzhin pa thams cad dang*/ khyed rang gi shes rgyud kyi steng na yod pa'i dge rtsa ji snyed yod pa thams cad blos phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas ye shes kyi me'i rnam par gyur/ me de nyid kyis bsreg bya sdig pa'i bud shing sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad bsreg bya sreg byed bral ba'i tshul gyis bsregs pas khyed rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo skye ba med pa rdo rje chos su gnas pa de nyid 'di nas skar mda' 'phang pa bzhin du mkha' la spyod pa'i zhing khams su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs 'bring du 'khod de/ der yang gsal stong 'dzin pa ma mchis pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ zhes brda' sprad/ slob dpon rnams kyis dril bsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ (rgya gar gyi slob dpon stong nyid rig 'dzin rdo rjes gsang ba 'dus pa'i dus mtha'i cho gar/)

stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes/ tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ ye shes snang ba 'bar gyur cig / ces lan gsum brjod pa'i dang po gnyis kyi rjes su byang bu me la yul ba re dang*/ gsum pa'i dus me spar/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing rol mo bya/ dmigs yul de nyid/ cho ga byed po rang nyid/ ji ltar sbyong ba'i tshul dang gsum rang sems las logs su gyur pa cung zad kyang med pas sems snang tsam dang*/ sems de yang gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du bzhag shes rab lta bas rgyas 'debs pa gal che/ slob dpon gyis byang ro legs par brtag la kha dmar gdags/ thal ba de 'jim pa dang bsres sa tstsha 'debs/ de nas lam sbyangs bstan pa ni/ slob dpon gyis dril bsil me tog 'thor zhing*/ gdangs dang bcas pas/ (gtsug dgu'i rgyud las/) dkon mchog rin chen dpal bzhin du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba'i// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen 'phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang bsgoms pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam// rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun sbyang ste// 'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog /oṃ ratne ratne ma hā ratne ki ratne ma la bi shuddhe sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ tra tha/ ces brjod cing rol mo bya/ /sbyong rgyud las/ padma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos dang*// srid pa'i padmo las byung ba'i// mkha' spyod gnas su skye bar shog oṃ padme padme padma saṃ bha we ma hā su kha gatstshantu swā hā/ zhes brjod cing rol mo bya ste mkha' spyod tu skyes par bsam/ slob dpon gyis der skyes pa'i byang sems rnying pa rnams kyis mchis kyi de la mchod par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ nas shabda 'i bar brjod cing rol mo bya/

des kyang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod par gyur bar bsam la/ sngar ltar mchod cing rol mo bya/ der skyes pa'i rgyu brtags pas rdo rje slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa'i cho ga'i nus mthu yin par shes te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dir 'ongs te bdag dang dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsams la/ sngar ltar mchod cing rol mo bya/ e ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs// gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs// byang chub spyod pa nyid la bkod// ces ched du brjod par bsam/ bdag gis kyang slar de la mchod par gyur par bsam la sngar ltar mchod rol bya zhing*/ slar dag pa mkha' spyod du song bar bsam zhing me tog gtor/ de nas skabs 'dir bsngo ba bya zhing smon lam rgyas par bya'o// rjes chog ni dkyil chog sbyong rgyud las gsungs pa ltar ro// de ltar mkha' spyod rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// brten nas dmigs yul thar pa bsgrod pa'i thabs// lho sgo'i cho ga legs par bris pa'i dges// 'gro kun thar lam bsgrod pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bdag blo dman zhing sbyangs pa chung ba'i phyir// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i blo dman 'ba' zhig la// phan pa srid snyam tsham tshom med par bris// de lta na yang gong ma'i gsung rab dang*// drin can bla ma'i phyag bzhes 'khrul med pa// rang bzo spangs te legs par bkod pa'i dges// bskul ba po yi bzhed dgongs mthar phyin shog / ces pa 'di yang pha bla ma mkhyen rab rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' 'bangs kyi tha chung lhun grub kyis bgrang bzhi bcu phrag bdun du slebs pa mdzes byed kyi lo rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs dge bar dben gnas rmor dgon par bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni lho brag shing dgon pa bka' bcu ba kun bsam gyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang lus can ma lus thar lam bsgrod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༈ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/

ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samya ksaṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne shuddhe bi shuddhe sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shuddhe swā hā/ ༈ /na mo ratna tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa ra ṇi me sarba satwā nāñtsa swā hā/ oṃ padmo uṣṇi ṣa bi ma le hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a mi de wa hrīḥ dge legs 'phel// smras pa/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄// rdor gling ma hā kal gnas bsdod a lcags skyid 'dzoms lags nas tshe 'das dpal 'byor nor bu lags dang*/ bal yul gnas bsdod mig dmar lags nas/ tshe 'das pha co 'gyur med lags dang*/ tshe 'das bstan pa chos sgrub bcas kyi ched du rgyu yon sbyar bar rten/ rdor gling khar shang sa skya kun dga' bshad sgrub gling nas/ 2003 spyi zla 6 tshes 24 nyin spar skrun zhus// //spar rtsa bal yul nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las spel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
